edges.reason: executeProposal conditionally calls GOV_VESTING.release()
executeProposal queries GOV_VESTING.vestedAmount()
executeProposal queries GOV_VESTING.released()
executeProposal queries GOV_VESTING.startTimestamp()
executeProposal invokes TORN.transfer
executeProposal invokes TORN.approve
executeProposal invokes SABLIER.createStream
GOV_VESTING is the target of the vestedAmount query
GOV_VESTING is the target of the release call
GOV_VESTING is the target of the released query
GOV_VESTING is the target of the startTimestamp query
block.timestamp is used to compute elapsedMonths, making execution time dependent
startTimestamp result feeds the elapsedMonths computation
SECOND_PER_MONTH divides the elapsed time into months
released() return value is stored in releasedFunds
releasedFunds determines the transferred amount
PERCENT_OF_TREASURY scales the transferred amount
HUNDRED is the divisor for the percentage calculation
COMMUNITY_MULTISIG is the transfer recipient
TORN is the token contract used for the transfer

elapsedMonths is the divisor in the vestingPerMonth calculation
vestingPerMonth is scaled into sablierDeposit
MONTH_PER_YEAR multiplies the monthly vesting amount
PERCENT_OF_TREASURY scales the stream deposit
HUNDRED is the divisor of the deposit percentage
sablierDeposit is rounded down into sablierAdjustedDeposit via modulo
SECOND_PER_YEAR is the modulus applied to the deposit
sablierAdjustedDeposit is the approved allowance amount
TORN is the token contract used for approve
SABLIER is the spender of the approve call
sablierAdjustedDeposit is the stream deposit amount
COMMUNITY_MULTISIG is the stream recipient
TORN is the streamed token address
block.timestamp defines the stream start and end, making the operation time dependent
SECOND_PER_YEAR sets the stream duration
SABLIER is the contract receiving the createStream call

External TORN.approve call can reenter executeProposal
External SABLIER.createStream call can reenter executeProposal

normalization_plan.reason: releasedFunds is a temporary holding of the GOV_VESTING.released() return value and can be folded into that core external call
elapsedMonths is derived directly from the GOV_VESTING.startTimestamp() query and block.timestamp and can be folded into that core call
vestingPerMonth exists only to size the Sablier stream deposit and can be folded into SABLIER.createStream
sablierDeposit is an intermediate stream amount computed solely for SABLIER.createStream
sablierAdjustedDeposit is the final rounded stream deposit consumed by SABLIER.createStream and TORN.approve
